hero.desc: Hey. I'm Angie Plazas, a transdisciplinary Fullstack Developer operating at the intersection of generative art, creative coding, mathematics, and modern web engineering. I explore digital aesthetics the way one studies a living organism — with curiosity, with code, and with a bit of chaos.
hero.caption: Eulophia alta (Orchidaceae) seed micrograph

about.title: 01 // Background
about.heading: Closing the gap between rigid logic and organic expression.
about.p1: My path into development didn't start with the tech boom or the desire to build standard apps. It started long ago, with a genuine interest in how simple computational rules can generate infinitely complex and beautiful patterns.
about.p2: As a creative coder, I work with JavaScript, P5.js, WebGL, Three.js, and React, along with mathematical algorithms (Python); I also explore agents, generative systems and scientific material to build interactive experiences that blur the line between utility and art. I think of myself as an explorer of complexity: I take abstract systems and give them a sensitive, visual and, at times, interactive form.
about.focus: My approach is clean, modular and alive: I look for clarity in structure and creative freedom. I believe well-designed software has something intrinsically attractive, and that aesthetic experiences can greatly elevate what we use every day.
about.p3: I find it interesting to see code as a living system: being able to follow its patterns, alter its rules and leave room for something not fully planned to emerge. In that small, almost entropic drift is where I tend to find the creative.

ai.title: 01.5 // AI Engineering Focus
ai.heading: Agents, RAG & Applied AI
ai.desc: I design and ship practical AI systems: from tool-calling agents to retrieval-augmented assistants. The goal isn't “chat with everything”, it's solving a specific problem with the right context.

items.title: Agentic Systems
items.desc: Goal-oriented agents with tool calling, structured outputs, memory and pragmatic guardrails for real tasks.

items.title: RAG & Context
items.desc: Grounding LLMs with curated project/repo data via embeddings, smart chunking and retrieval to keep answers precise and useful.

items.title: MCP & Tool Use
items.desc: Exploring the Model Context Protocol to safely connect agents to real tools (files, APIs, repos) instead of just chatting.

items.title: Applied AI Products
items.desc: Turning agentic ideas into usable, product-focused apps with clean UX, orchestration and traceable logic.

kb.a: I'm Angie Plazas — a transdisciplinary Frontend & AI Engineer. I build at the intersection of generative art, creative coding, mathematics, web engineering and applied AI (agents, RAG, tool calling).

Core: TypeScript, Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Node.js. Creative: WebGL/GLSL, Three.js, P5.js. AI: LLMs, Groq API, Vercel AI SDK, Agents, RAG, Tool Calling, MCP, local AI with Ollama. Also exploring bioinformatics & audio processing.

Featured: Cellular Automata Engine (WebGL/GLSL), AI Code Assistant (Groq + Llama + Three.js), Anxiety Companion (FastAPI + React + LLM with guardrails), Genome Cleaner (bioinformatics CLI), Endmoda (fashion gallery).
Actively building with agents, tool calling, RAG, MCP and local/open-source AI. Focus: turn manual flows into useful agentic tools with the right context (grounding > chat for everything).
Open to Frontend/AI-leaning roles. Reach me via the contact form or aplazasn@unal.edu.co. Portfolio: https://noomesk.vercel.app/

art.title: Generative Art
art.description: Exploring the edges of digital growth, biological patterns, and algorithmic serendipity.
art.vjSectionDesc: Creation of visual identity and conceptual themes for live musical acts using rhythmic synchronization and real-time mixing. Rather than relying on commercial visual software, the entire set is coded from scratch: Perlin noise, Mandelbrot fractals, and WebGL custom shaders in wtc-gl modulated live with Tweakpane. Graphics, colors, and transitions morph dynamically, responding to the low frequencies, melodies, and drops of the sound set.
art.footer: Hardware Accelerated Decoder • Bio-Art Sync v5.0

piece1.title: Fractal Growth
piece1.subtitle: Seeds of Cleome gynandra (Capparaceae) mixed with Delphinium peregrinum (Ranunculaceae). Algorithmic exploration of plant morphology and generative seed distribution patterns.
piece1.caption: [ Piece 001 ] — Biologically inspired generative art

piece2.title: Neural Flow
piece2.subtitle: Pterois volitans (lionfish) in motion. Movement simulated using Mandelbrot sets to calculate rhythmic cycles of fading and emergence. Hardware-accelerated decoder · Bio-Art Sync v5.0
piece2.caption: [ Piece 002 ] — Biologically inspired generative art

vjPiece1.title: FLUIDO
vjPiece1.subtitle: Generative live mixing synchronized to the beat. Fluid color transitions and vortex structures react dynamically to the low frequencies and melodies of the sound set.
vjPiece1.caption: [ VJ Set 001 ] — Real-time coded generative mix

vjPiece2.title: Entropic
vjPiece2.subtitle: Exploration of entropy and structured chaos. Fractal algorithms and Perlin noise modulate speed and shape transitions in sync with the beats and drops.
vjPiece2.caption: [ VJ Set 002 ] — Real-time coded generative mix
